name: harness-videos
description: Product films for the Harness web UI, built with Remotion. Separate workspace: it never resolves the web app's Tailwind.

scripts.audio: uv run --no-project --with numpy --with imageio-ffmpeg python3 scripts/music.py && uv run --no-project --with numpy --with imageio-ffmpeg python3 scripts/sfx.py
scripts.beats: mkdir -p out && uv run --no-project --with numpy --with imageio-ffmpeg python3 scripts/beats.py --drums public/audio/demo-b/stems/drums.wav --out out/beats-tempo.json && uv run --no-project --with numpy --with imageio-ffmpeg python3 scripts/beats.py --drums public/audio/demo-b/stems/kick.wav --bpm 99.999 --stem hats=public/audio/demo-b/stems/hats.wav --stem pad=public/audio/demo-b/stems/pad.wav --stem pluck=public/audio/demo-b/stems/pluck.wav --stem bass=public/audio/demo-b/stems/bass.wav --out src/videos/demo-b/beats.json
scripts.verify: uv run --no-project --with numpy --with imageio-ffmpeg python3 scripts/verify.py out/demo-b --duration 120 --bg 247,247,244 --no-seam
